1521:def pts_to_prestep(x, *args):
1522:    """
1523:    Convert continuous line to pre-steps.
1524:
1525:    Given a set of ``N`` points, convert to ``2N - 1`` points, which when
1526:    connected linearly give a step function which changes values at the
1527:    beginning of the intervals.
1528:
1529:    Parameters
1530:    ----------
1531:    x : array
1532:        The x location of the steps. May be empty.
1533:
1534:    y1, ..., yp : array
1535:        y arrays to be turned into steps; all must be the same length as ``x``.
1536:
1537:    Returns
1538:    -------
1539:    array
1540:        The x and y values converted to steps in the same order as the input;
1541:        can be unpacked as ``x_out, y1_out, ..., yp_out``.  If the input is
1542:        length ``N``, each of these arrays will be length ``2N + 1``. For
1543:        ``N=0``, the length will be 0.
1544:
1545:    Examples
1546:    --------
1547:    >>> x_s, y1_s, y2_s = pts_to_prestep(x, y1, y2)
